integrity: Exact block matrices, all-boundary rank computations, and independent direct modular linear-system checker included.
scientific_limitations: Only restricted simple sl2 modules of highest weights 0 through p-1 over fields of odd characteristic. No characteristic-two or unrestricted-module claim. Literature priority provisional; small finite-field checks are supplemental to a complete symbolic proof.
title: Modular collision of \(\delta\)-derivation spectra for restricted simple \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)-modules
